Late-payment interest, PER ANNUM. Supplier Agreement clause: "late-payment interest at the maximum rate permitted under UAE law (currently up to 9% per annum under Federal Decree-Law...)". Founder said 9% monthly verbally; the signed agreement says per annum and frames 9% as the legal maximum, so the document governs. Changing this to a monthly basis requires amending the Supplier Agreement first.

Until it is written into the Supplier Agreement it is not contractually recoverable and a supplier could refuse it. Set to 250 as instructed; the terms need updating to match.
